label: Reconstructed Spinozist immanence as ontology of radical democratic freedom
description: Across A Nervura do Real and decades of scholarship, Chaui developed Spinoza’s immanent causality into a major Latin American political philosophy of collective potency.
dialecticalTension: Reclaims Spinoza against authoritarian political theology in Brazil.

label: Extended Merleau-Ponty’s phenomenology of culture to democratic ideology critique
description: Studying Merleau-Ponty’s embodied expression, Chaui analyzed how technocratic "competent discourse" silences democratic participation.
dialecticalTension: Connects French phenomenology of expression to Brazilian cultural politics.

label: Synthesized Marxist ideology critique with Spinoza to diagnose Brazilian authoritarianism
description: Chaui analyzed Brazil’s "founding myth" of harmonious cordiality as an ideological veil masking violent class and racial hierarchy.
dialecticalTension: Bridges Spinoza, Merleau-Ponty, and Marx against Brazilian authoritarianism.
historicalContext: Brasil: Mito Fundador e Sociedade Autoritária (2000).

citations.author: Marilena Chaui
